Subject: Portal onboarding request — SIG/CAIQ + evidence cadence

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the intro last week. We are ready to onboard Redwood into Evergreen Health's vendor security program. To scope the intake up front: we need a completed SIG/CAIQ (we prefer the SIG spreadsheet) and a small set of evidence for SOC 2 controls in scope (encryption at rest, IAM, logging).

Can you confirm whether you prefer to be provisioned in Whistic or OneTrust? Our preference is Whistic but we can add a temporary S3/HTTP upload if that is easier.

Target timeline: we'd like the portal profile created and initial evidence uploaded within two weeks (by 2026-09-26). We have attached our SIG template and a network diagram to help with mapping.

Attachments: (attachment: SIG_Template_v2.xlsx - excel), (attachment: evergreen_network_diagram.pdf - pdf)

If you can send a short kickoff plan and point person, we will provision access and SSO.

Thanks,
Alyssa Moran
Vendor Risk Manager
Evergreen Health

Subject: Re: Portal onboarding request — SIG/CAIQ + evidence cadence

Hi all — Rishi (Security). A couple of quick items from security review before we kick off: 

1) Evidence scope: For the initial push please include:
   - Configuration screenshots for KMS keys and envelope policies (or KMS admin console exports)
   - IAM role list showing least-privilege (or an IAM permissions matrix)
   - Audit log retention policy and one sample log export (syslog/cloudtrail)

2) Access model: we prefer a portal-based proof-of-possession approach (Whistic) — please make sure temporary download links expire in 72 hours. If you require SFTP, we need the host and an account to test before the sprint.

3) Redaction: sensitive PHI/PII should be redacted; mark any redactions in a manifest.

I will take point on reviewing the uploaded artifacts. If we need deeper context on architecture I'll ask for an architecture walk (30m).

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
